body: Full arc: cloned the new CarePyre repo, ingested a 179-page Gemini conversation PDF (pypdf, --user --break-system-packages install after a hand-rolled extractor failed on Chrome's hex-encoded font glyphs) that turned out to contain the real CarePyre venture plan -- a community-owned trust building telecom mesh, digital identity, AI navigation, and financial protection infrastructure for Pontiac, MI, positioned to eventually compete with Centene/Meridian in Michigan Medicaid managed care. Built a landing page explicitly excluding the Medicaid-MCO-displacement competitive strategy and capitation-rate specifics per founder instruction -- public content covers mission, the 4-layer C.H.A.N.G.E. stack, and the Trust/Foundation/Co-op structure only. Founder redirected design mid-build (dark ember/fire theme -> light blue/white/cyan/orange, healthcare-friendly) -- wrote STYLE_GUIDE.md first per explicit instruction, then rebuilt index.html against it. Prepared ops/nginx-carepyre.conf + sudo-queue/13-carepyre-domain-setup.sh (same pattern as okemily.com's own standup, since Claude has no sudo access) -- founder ran it. Confirmed live: https://carepyre.org/ returns 200 with a real cert, HTTP redirects to HTTPS, okemily.com unaffected. Per explicit founder instruction, NOT registered in EMILY/context/golden-docs-index.md -- CarePyre stays outside the normal RSI-loop golden-doc system until an integrate/divest decision is made. CarePyre commits ee8e31a, d7ad5be; root monorepo commit d134029 (sudo-queue script, local-only).
title: CarePyre: landing site built, styled, and deployed live at carepyre.org
